arxiv-2201-03328.title: Detection of the tidal deformation of WASP-103b at 3 ​ σ 3\,\sigma with CHEOPS
arxiv-2201-03328.creator: S. C. C. Barros, B. Akinsanmi, G. Boué, A. M. S. Smith, J. Laskar, S. Ulmer-Moll, J. Lillo-Box, D. Queloz, A. Collier Cameron, S. G. Sousa, D. Ehrenreich, M. J. Hooton, G. Bruno, B.-O. Demory, A. C. M. Correia, O. D. S. Demangeon, T. G. Wilson, A. Bonfanti, S. Hoyer, Y. Alibert, R. Alonso, G. Anglad
arxiv-2201-03328.description: Abstract Context. Ultra-short period planets undergo strong tidal interactions with their host star which lead to planet deformation and orbital tidal decay. Aims. WASP-103b is the exoplanet with the highest expected deformation signature in its transit light curve and one of the shortest expected spiral-in times.

arxiv-2203-06905.title: Less is More: Proxy Datasets in NAS approaches
arxiv-2203-06905.creator: Brian Moser, Federico Raue, Jörn Hees, Andreas Dengel
arxiv-2203-06905.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Brian Moser, Federico Raue, Jörn Hees, Andreas Dengel. Neural Architecture Search (NAS) defines the design of Neural Networks as a search problem. Unfortunately, NAS is computationally intensive because of various possibilities depending on the number of elements in the design and the possible connections between them. In this work, we extensively analyze the role of the dataset size based on several sampling approaches for reducing the dataset size (unsupervised and supervised cases) as an agnostic approach to reduce search time.

arxiv-2207-03858.title: DSTEA: Improving Dialogue State Tracking via Entity Adaptive Pre-training
arxiv-2207-03858.creator: Yukyung Lee, Takyoung Kim, Hoonsang Yoon, Pilsung Kang, Junseong Bang, Misuk Kim
arxiv-2207-03858.description: Abstract Dialogue State Tracking (DST) is critical for comprehensively interpreting user and system utterances, thereby forming the cornerstone of efficient dialogue systems. Despite past research efforts focused on enhancing DST performance through alterations to the model structure or integrating additional features like graph relations, they often require additional pre-training with external dialogue corpora.

arxiv-2305-02713.title: Seen and unseen: bursty star formation and its implications for observations of high-redshift galaxies with JWST 2023 Seen and unseen: bursty star formation and its implications for observations of high-redshift galaxies with JWST – References
arxiv-2305-02713.creator: Guochao Sun, Claude-André Faucher-Giguère, Christopher C. Hayward, Xuejian Shen
arxiv-2305-02713.description: Abstract Both observations and simulations have shown strong evidence for highly time-variable star formation in low-mass and/or high-redshift galaxies, which has important observational implications because high-redshift galaxy samples are rest-UV selected and therefore particularly sensitive to the recent star formation.

arxiv-2307-14129.title: Macroscopic Market Making
arxiv-2307-14129.creator: Ivan Guo Shijia Jin Kihun Nam
arxiv-2307-14129.description: Abstract . We propose a macroscopic market making model à la Avellaneda-Stoikov, using continuous processes for orders instead of discrete point processes. The model intends to bridge the gap between market making and optimal execution problems, while shedding light on the influence of order flows on the optimal strategies. We demonstrate our model through three problems.

arxiv-2312-00845.title: VMC: Video Motion Customization using Temporal Attention Adaption for Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
arxiv-2312-00845.creator: Hyeonho Jeong 1, Geon Yeong Park 2, Jong Chul Ye 1 , 2
arxiv-2312-00845.description: Abstract Text-to-video diffusion models have advanced video generation significantly. However, customizing these models to generate videos with tailored motions presents a substantial challenge. In specific, they encounter hurdles in ( a ) accurately reproducing motion from a target video, and ( b ) creating diverse visual variations.

arxiv-2312-11087.title: Few-cycle optical vortices for strong field physics Journal: opticajournal
arxiv-2312-11087.creator: Matthieu Guer, Martin Luttmann, Jean-François Hergott, Fabien Lepetit, Olivier Tcherbakoff, Thierry Ruchon, Romain Géneaux
arxiv-2312-11087.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Matthieu Guer, Martin Luttmann, Jean-François Hergott, Fabien Lepetit, Olivier Tcherbakoff, Thierry Ruchon, Romain Géneaux. We report on the generation of optical vortices with few-cycle pulse durations, 500 μ \mu J per pulse, at a repetition rate of 1 kHz. To do so, a 25 fs laser beam at 800 nm is shaped with a helical phase and coupled into a hollow core fiber filled with argon gas, in which it undergoes self phase modulation.

arxiv-2406-20054.title: To Word Senses and Beyond: Inducing Concepts with Contextualized Language Models
arxiv-2406-20054.creator: Bastien Liétard, Pascal Denis, Mikaela Keller
arxiv-2406-20054.description: Abstract Polysemy and synonymy are two crucial interrelated facets of lexical ambiguity. While both phenomena are widely documented in lexical resources and have been studied extensively in NLP, leading to dedicated systems, they are often being considered independently in practictal problems. While many tasks dealing with polysemy (e.g.

arxiv-2503-00593.title: Electromagnetic Electron Kelvin-Helmholtz Instability
arxiv-2503-00593.creator: H. Che, G. P. Zank
arxiv-2503-00593.description: Abstract On electron kinetic scales, ions and electrons decouple, and electron velocity shear on electron inertial length ∼ d e \sim d_{e} can trigger electromagnetic (EM) electron Kelvin-Helmholtz instability (EKHI). In this paper, we present an analytic study of EM EKHI in an inviscid collisionless plasma with a step-function electron shear flow.

arxiv-2503-04676.title: Characterizing S = 3 / 2 S=3/2 AKLT Hamiltonian with Scanning Tunneling Spectroscopy
arxiv-2503-04676.creator: M. Ferri-Cortés 1 , J. C. G. Henriques 2,3 , J. Fernández-Rossier 3
arxiv-2503-04676.description: Abstract The AKLT Hamiltonian is a particular instance of a general class of model Hamiltonians defined in lattices with coordination z z where each site hosts a spins S = z / 2 S=z/2 , interacting both with linear and non-linear exchange couplings.

arxiv-2508-18902.title: Adaptive 6G Networks-in-Network Management for Industrial Applications
arxiv-2508-18902.creator: Daniel Lindenschmitt, Paul Seehofer, Marius Schmitz, Jan Mertes, Roland Bless, Martina Zitterbart, Jan C. Aurich, Hans D. Schotten
arxiv-2508-18902.description: Abstract This paper presents the application of dsm ( dsm ) for future 6G industrial networks, establishing an efficient controller for the nin ( nin ) concept. The proposed architecture integrates nomadic as well as static sn with diverse qos ( qos ) requirements within the coverage area of an overlayer network, managed by a centralized sm ( sm ).

arxiv-2510-19340.title: CoRECT: A Framework for Evaluating Embedding Compression Techniques at Scale
arxiv-2510-19340.creator: Laura Caspari, Michael Dinzinger, Kanishka Ghosh Dastidar, Christofer Fellicious, Jelena Mitrović, Michael Granitzer
arxiv-2510-19340.description: Abstract Dense retrieval systems have proven to be effective across various benchmarks, but require substantial memory to store large search indices. Recent advances in embedding compression show that index sizes can be greatly reduced with minimal loss in ranking quality.

arxiv-2511-08578.title: Early Formation of Supermassive Black Holes via Dark Star Gravitational Instability
arxiv-2511-08578.creator: Katherine Freese, George M. Fuller, Sohan Ghodla, Cosmin Ilie, Kyle S. Kehrer, Tanja Rindler-Daller, Evangelos I. Sfakianakis
arxiv-2511-08578.description: Abstract We show that dark stars, which are dark-matter-powered stars in the early universe, can grow by accretion to masses in the range 𝒪 ⁡ ( 10 4 ) − 𝒪 ⁡ ( 10 7 ) ​ M ⊙ {\cal O}\left({10}^{4}\right)-{\cal O}\left({10}^{7}\right)\,{M_{\odot}} before the general-relativistic Feynman-Chandrasekhar instability causes their dynamical collapse to black holes.

arxiv-2512-17344.title: Governance-Aware Hybrid Fine-Tuning for Multilingual Large Language Models
arxiv-2512-17344.creator: Haomin Qi 1 , Chengbo Huang 2 , Zihan Dai 3 , Yunkai Gao 4
arxiv-2512-17344.description: Abstract We present a governance-aware hybrid fine-tuning framework for multilingual, low-resource adaptation of large language models. The core algorithm mixes gradient-aligned low-rank updates with structured orthogonal transformations through layer-wise mixing and introduces unitary constraints in selected sub-layers to stabilize deep optimization.

The aim of this study was to compare the results from the QFT with those from the tu

pmc-11465915.title: Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation for tuberculosis-related acute respiratory distress syndrome: An international multicentre retrospective cohort study
pmc-11465915.creator: Ali Ait Hssain, Matthieu Petit, Clemens Wiest, Laura Simon, Abdulrahman A Al-Fares, Ahmed Hany, Dafna I Garcia-Gomez, Santiago Besa, Saad Nseir, Christophe Guervilly, Wael Alqassem, Mathieu Lesouhaitier, Adrian Chelaru, Simon WC Sin, Roberto Roncon-Albuquerque, Marco Giani, Philipp M Lepper, Jean-Ré
pmc-11465915.description: ObjectiveTo report the outcomes of patients with severe tuberculosis (TB)-related acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) on extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO), including predictors of 90-day mortality and associated complications.MethodsAn international multicenter retrospective study was conducted in 20 ECMO centers across 13 countries between 2002 and 2022.

pmc-11603070.title: Automated brain tumor recognition using equilibrium optimizer with deep learning approach on MRI images
pmc-11603070.creator: Mahmoud Ragab, Iyad Katib, Sanaa A Sharaf, Hassan A Alterazi, Alanoud Subahi, Sana G Alattas, Sami Saeed Binyamin, Jaber Alyami
pmc-11603070.description: Brain tumours (BT) affect human health owing to their location. Artificial intelligence (AI) is intended to assist in diagnosing and treating complex diseases by combining technologies like deep learning (DL), big data analytics, and machine learning (ML). AI can identify and categorize tumours by analyzing brain imaging approaches like Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI).

pmc-12471838.title: Pyogenic Spondylodiscitis: Predictors of Microbiological Yield from Biopsy in a Tertiary Hospital
pmc-12471838.creator: Aslı Haykır Solay, Dilek Bulut, Gülnur Kul, Semanur Kuzi, Muhammed Erkan Emrahoğlu, İhsaniye Süer Doğan, Nesibe Korkmaz, Ayşenur Soykuvvet Ayhan, Fatma Şanlı, Mustafa Kavcar, Saffet Öztürk, Gönül Çiçek Şentürk
pmc-12471838.description: Background and Objectives: Pyogenic spondylodiscitis (SD) is a severe spinal infection involving the intervertebral disc and adjacent vertebrae and is often associated with significant morbidity. Identifying the causative microorganism is crucial for targeted treatment; however, the microbiological yield from blood or tissue cultures varies widely due to factors such as prior antibiotic use and biopsy technique.

pmc-12593763.title: Exercise Stress Echocardiography Predicts Adverse Cardiovascular Events in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: A 5-Year Prospective Study
pmc-12593763.creator: Ye Su, Chunmei Li, Qionghui Peng, Lixue Yin
pmc-12593763.description: Background:Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is an autosomal dominant genetic disorder and a primary cause of sudden cardiac death (SCD) in young individuals. Studies have demonstrated that “left atrial strain” serves as a predictive marker for adverse cardiovascular events in diseases such as heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, moderate aortic stenosis, and diastolic dysfunction.

pmc-12753941.title: Bioinformatic and experimental identification and characterization of Clostridioides difficile lipoproteins as potential vaccine candidates
pmc-12753941.creator: Soumyadeep Chakraborty, Joshua Heuler, Shaohui Wang, Junling Qin, Adrit Roy, Lubem Nathanel Agbendeh, Anastasia Tomatsidou, Hyeun Bum Kim, Xingmin Sun
pmc-12753941.description: IntroductionTreatment options for C. difficile infection are limited, with very high rates of recurrence. Active vaccination provides an attractive opportunity to prevent C. difficile infection (CDI) and recurrence. In a search for potential surface-exposed antigens involved in C. difficile colonization, two putative lipoproteins, designated LP1 and LP2, were identified from C. difficile R20291.

pmc-13292001.title: Carbene–Ketene Formal [3 + 2] Cycloaddition Enabled by Visible-Light-Induced Dual Photolysis of Diazo Compounds
pmc-13292001.creator: Longlong Fang, Xiaojian Ren, Tingting Liu, Fengya He, Jing Zhu, Bao-Gui Cai, Yu Lu, Jun Xuan, Chenggui Wu
pmc-13292001.description: Diazo compounds have long been employed through two distinct reaction pathways: carbene transfer and ketene formation, which rarely intersect within a single reaction environment. Here, we report a visible-light-induced dual photolysis strategy that unifies these divergent pathways by selectively activating two distinct diazo precursors to generate a free carbene and a ketene in situ.

pmc-13631778.creator: Jiajuan Ji, Yuting Zhu, Dan Luo, Peiwen Ding, Huibo Li, Yanqiu Zhao, Zhibo Guo, Qi Li, Jie Liu, Dan Guo, Yujuan Gao, Shengjin Fan
pmc-13631778.description: BackgroundDifferentiation syndrome (DS) is a potentially life-threatening complication during induction therapy for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL). Previous studies have linked white blood cell (WBC) elevation with DS development; however, conventional WBC-based assessment mainly relies on peak values and does not adequately reflect the dynamic pattern or timing of WBC changes.
